summary: Full backend + frontend test of Testify MVP. All 26 backend pytest cases PASSED covering auth (register/login/me/forgot/reset), workspace, onboarding, collections CRUD (incl. cross-workspace 404), testimonials CRUD & filters, upload (image+reject bad mime), widgets CRUD (with merge), public collection & submission (consent/empty/honeypot rejections), public widget (only approved, no private field leaks), widget.js, analytics/overview, and full E2E propagation (submit -> approve -> appears in widget -> edit -> reflected). Frontend: landing loads with hero/how-it-works/pricing/FAQ; admin login redirects to /dashboard; Overview shows stat cards (7 total, 2 new, 5 approved) and recent testimonials with approve/view buttons; Testimonials page renders with data-testid approve-<id> selectors; Widget builder loads, live preview renders 6+ testimonials, layout switcher visible (Grid/Carousel/Masonry/Single/Video Wall), 'Get embed code' opens dialog with <script src=... data-widget-id=...> snippet and 'Copy embed code' button; public /t/testify-demo renders both 'Record a video' and 'Write a testimonial' options with data-testids.

issues: <label>First name *</label> etc. are not associated with their inputs via htmlFor/id — get_by_label fails and screen readers won't announce field names. Add htmlFor + matching id, or wrap input inside <label>. Applies to First name, Last name, Email, Company, Job title.

action_items: (Minor a11y) Associate form labels with inputs on PublicCollection.jsx submission form via htmlFor+id.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 841 lines is borderline; recommend splitting routers (auth, collections, testimonials, widgets, public) into separate modules for maintainability.

auth.seed_admin() only updates password when admin already exists — if the admin was never created by seed script, /api/auth/login with admin@testify.com/admin123 would fail. Confirmed seed ran (login works), but consider making seed_admin idempotently create the admin+workspace.
verify_recaptcha silently returns True when RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY missing — expected per config, but consider logging a warning at startup so it's visible.
In-memory rate limiter (_rate_store) won't work across multiple workers/pods. OK for MVP; document for prod migration to Redis.
email_service returns 'mock' when RESEND_API_KEY missing — behavior confirmed non-blocking.
CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False. Fine for JWT-in-header, but tighten origins in production.

public/collection/{slug}/submit records email but doesn't gate on require_email flag — a required_email=True collection will still accept submissions without email. Consider enforcing when col.require_email is True.
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral test users (test_*@example.com) via /api/auth/register during onboarding & cross-workspace tests. Test testimonials prefixed with TEST/E2E_ were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). Uses admin@testify.com/admin123. reCAPTCHA + Resend intentionally mocked (no keys) — do NOT flag. Frontend flows verified: login, Overview, Testimonials (approve-<id>), Widget Builder (get-embed-btn, copy-embed-btn), Public collection page (pick-text, pick-video, testimonial-text, consent-checkbox, submit-testimonial-btn). Public form has minor label htmlFor/id a11y gap.
